Perform a variable-cell relaxation (vc-relax) of BiFeO3 in the R3c perovskite structure (10 atoms, 2 formula units per primitive cell), followed by a self-consistent field (SCF) total-energy calculation on the relaxed structure.
Use the LDA PseudoDojo SR_v0.4.1 standard pseudopotentials: bi.upf, fe.upf, and o.upf from PseudoDojo/SR_v0.4.1/LDA_standard/.
Use the experimental R3c BiFeO3 structure in the hexagonal setting as the starting configuration, with lattice parameters a = 5.58 Å, c = 13.86 Å, and the standard R3c atomic displacements for 2 formula units (10 atoms).
Set ecutwfc = 70 Ry and ecutrho = 400 Ry.
Use an automatic Monkhorst-Pack k-point grid of 3x3x2 with a half shift (shifted grid, not Gamma-centered).
Set etot_conv_thr = 1.0e-8, forc_conv_thr = 1.0e-7, and conv_thr = 1.0e-8.
Use fixed occupations (no smearing), consistent with BiFeO3 being a band insulator.
Assign a starting magnetic moment of 5 Bohr magnetons to each Fe atom with all Fe moments parallel (ferromagnetic starting guess). Do not apply Hubbard U or spin-orbit coupling.
In the vc-relax step, allow all ions to move and all cell parameters (lengths and angles) to relax freely.
After the vc-relax converges, run an SCF calculation on the fully relaxed structure using the same pseudopotentials, ecutwfc, ecutrho, k-point grid, convergence thresholds, occupations, and magnetic ordering.
Return the fully relaxed atomic structure (cell vectors and fractional/atomic coordinates of all 10 atoms) and the final SCF total energy.
